name: Orki USD
oneLiner: USDK was Orki's Liquity v2-style CDP stablecoin on Swellchain, frozen after the underlying chain shutdown in June 2026.

obituary.epitaph: A CDP stranded on a shuttered chain
obituary.obituary: Orki USDK was deployed only on Swellchain. Swellchain shut down its bridge flow in June 2026 and moved to halt chain operations on June 30, leaving remaining positions dependent on direct contract access or unrecoverable as the network wound down. Because USDK had no verified deployment outside Swellchain, Pharos freezes it as a discontinued single-chain CDP stablecoin.

collateral: WETH, weETH, rswETH, and swETH in overcollateralized Liquity v2-style CDP markets on Swellchain; the configured SWELL branch is currently shut down in live on-chain telemetry
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized CDP with Liquity v2-style user-set interest rates and direct on-chain redemption for underlying collateral; Stability Pools absorb liquidations per collateral market

notices.title: Swellchain shutdown deadline
notices.message: Swellchain's June 23, 2026 bridge-withdrawal deadline and June 30, 2026 chain-shutdown window have passed. Remaining USDK-related positions may require direct contract interaction and should be treated as effectively wound down.
